title: Longread
pitch: A long-form magazine article: one-line ledes, evidence glyphs with margin notes, and “Go deeper” panels that open in place.
bestFor: Arguments read top to bottom: build-vs-buy memos, technical or market assessments, explainers and comparisons where the reasoning matters as much as the answer. The default when unsure.
weakness: Still a linear article: skimmers scroll to find things, and it relies on a good one-line lede for every section.
signals: sections that each answer one question
a few charts or diagrams supporting prose
avoid: the model is the main event and every number should react (cockpit, notebook)
many parts whose relationships matter more than prose (blueprint)
a landscape to browse in any order (atlas)
